purpose: 145 / 144_prereg_e2.md v2: the second engine E2 of the fusion F (identity RRF K 10, alpha 0.5) in the B1 pipeline (experiments/b1_e2k)

e2_ik14_to_scorer.parquet.what: inchikey14 -> official scorer key of every train structure (computed from train.parquet SMILES with RDKit 2026.03.3; = the development library index of E2)

trainer: experiments/e2/e2_train.py (LightGBM binary, fixed parameters, rounds chosen by the fold 3 <-> 4 cross-fit only)
training_data: E-window tables (experiments/e2/b1_ewin.py + e2_feats.py) of the fold 3 / 4 pool molecules (train_pool_f3a/f3b/f4a/f4b, np061_f3pool/f4pool) built from the competition train.parquet spectra, the v2 pool / COCONUT / PubChemLite / ChEBI-LIPID MAPS structures of the public Kaggle datasets, and the fold-safe FPNet of each molecule's fold (public dataset casmi26-fold-safe-fpnet); no NIST-derived data
code: experiments/e2/{b1_ewin,e2_feats,e2_common,e2_train}.py in the team repository (training code available)
